english.title: Employee on ship fail to take reasonable care re handling / stowage / carriage of dangerous goods in ship

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Merchant Shipping Dangerous Goods and Marine Pollutants Regulations 1997

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employee aboard **(..SPECIFY SHIP..), a ship carrying dangerous goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), failed to comply with your duty

(A)_[to take reasonable care for the health and safety of yourself and other persons who may be affected by your acts and omissions]_
(B)_[to co-operate with your employer so far as was necessary to enable a duty or requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY DUTY OR REQUIREMENT..), imposed by the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 or a rule or regulation made thereunder with regard to the health and safety of persons aboard the ship to be complied with]_
(C)_[to co-operate with the operator of the ship so far as was necessary to enable a duty or requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY DUTY OR REQUIREMENT..), imposed by the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 or a rule or regulation made thereunder with regard to the health and safety of persons aboard the ship to be complied with]_

in connection with the handling, stowage and carriage of those goods in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7 of the Merchant Shipping (Dangerous Goods and Marine Pollutants) Regulations 1997.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 23 of the Merchant Shipping(Dangerous Goods and Marine Pollutants) Regulations 1997 provides that in any case where a ship does not comply with the requirementsof these Regulations the ship shall be liable to be detained and section 284 ofthe Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (which relates to the detention of a ship) shallhave effect in relation to the ship, subject to the modification that as if forthe words "this Act", wherever they appear, there were substituted the words"the Merchant Shipping (Dangerous Goods and Marine Pollutants) Regulations1997".
(ii) Regulation23 of the MerchantShipping (Dangerous Goods and Marine Pollutants) Regulations 1997 provides thatwhere the commission by any person of this offence isdue to the act or default of some other person, that other person shall beguilty of the offence, and a person may be charged with and convicted of theoffence by virtue of this regulation whether or not proceedings are takenagainst the first-mentioned person.
